def trafficLight(state: int) -> str:
    # Use only addition and subtraction to compute result
    # Map: 1 -> "red", 2 -> "yellow", 3 -> "green", else -> "unknown"
    
    # Check for 1
    temp = state - 1
    if temp == 0:
        return "red"
    
    # Check for 2
    temp = state - 2
    if temp == 0:
        return "yellow"
    
    # Check for 3
    temp = state - 3
    if temp == 0:
        return "green"
    
    # All other values
    return "unknown"


def main() -> None:
    # Test case 1: normal case - red
    result1 = trafficLight(1)
    print(result1)
    
    # Test case 2: normal case - yellow
    result2 = trafficLight(2)
    print(result2)
    
    # Test case 3: normal case - green
    result3 = trafficLight(3)
    print(result3)
    
    # Test case 4: edge case - zero
    result4 = trafficLight(0)
    print(result4)
    
    # Test case 5: edge case - negative value
    result5 = trafficLight(-1)
    print(result5)
    
    # Test case 6: edge case - large positive value
    result6 = trafficLight(100)
    print(result6)
    
    # Test case 7: boundary - just above valid range
    result7 = trafficLight(4)
    print(result7)
    
    # Test case 8: boundary - just below valid range
    result8 = trafficLight(0)
    print(result8)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
